limitations: Frame corners are rough board outlines, not normalization controls or asserted playable bounds.
Per-label points are rough visual reads with approximate pixel error, not subpixel measurements.
The diagram does not show a separate socket or sensor contact at each label. Part centers describe visible parts; lamp circles describe printed symbols.
SW51 and SW66 labels are all retained separately; without leaders they cannot establish which individual rubber or contact is meant.
The pin locations of flipper pivots are inferred from drawn rounded ends; especially the basement right flipper is obscured by its rail.
The SW36, SW46 and SW57 inscription points are not physical switch positions.
The independent reader visually inspected these drawings only; no independent second review has occurred.
Circled L text has no distinct socket symbol or leader on these pages, so it is retained as a balloon center and excluded from placement/check use.

primary_verification.status: Primary curator visually checked main, upper and basement control/measurement overlays against the retained native scans; all resulting locations remain observed.
exclusions: All label_center and balloon_center reads are excluded from physical lamp measurements.
The ambiguous main rear round opening is excluded as a control.
No frame corner is a coordinate control.

main_additional_control.basis: Independently read hatched up-kicker assembly; a mechanism projection, not an exact sensor centre.

primary_measurements.basis: Centre of the drawn six-digit display rectangle; primary visual read, approximate25px.
Independently read SW67 outhole bar; mechanism projection, extrapolated beyond flipper controls.
